about: Questions the seven Lives in lives-v1 can't answer; the right response is to decline (answerable=false). Checked 2026-11-15 by searching the text: Solon, Granicus, Lycurgus and Bucephalus don't appear; Cicero appears but his death isn't told. Two are general-knowledge traps (Cicero's death, Alexander's horse).

questions.question: What laws did Solon give the Athenians?
What happened at the battle of the Granicus?
What did Lycurgus decide about the Spartans' common meals?
What was the name of Alexander the Great's horse?
